project.name: servo-svg-engine
project.description: Servo's software SVG rendering engine: converts an SvgRenderTree into WebRender display-list commands, CPU-rasterizing complex paths and non-native gradients via vello_cpu while emitting simple shapes and native gradients as direct WebRender primitives, plus its layout-side integration (components/layout/svg).

nodes.name: fill.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the fill painting pipeline for rectangles and polygons, resolving solid colors, linear/radial gradients, and patterns into WebRender display-list commands (with CPU tessellation fallback for complex fills).

nodes.name: gradient.rs
nodes.summary: Gradient rasterization and rendering: sRGB/linear-RGB color interpolation, spread methods, gradient geometry resolution, and a strategy-based CPU rasterizer that emits native or cell-based WebRender gradient items.

nodes.name: stroke.rs
nodes.summary: Stroke painting pipeline: dash interval computation, stroked-rectangle (border) rendering, polyline stroke tessellation, gradient strokes, and per-segment rotated-rectangle emission into WebRender.

nodes.name: transform.rs
nodes.summary: Converts SVG transform ops into WebRender reference frames and layout transforms, computing scale factors and composing transform matrices for child rendering.

nodes.name: color.rs
nodes.summary: Parses CSS color strings (hex, named, rgb/rgba/hsl functions) into WebRender ColorF values, with unit tests.

nodes.name: fill.rs
nodes.summary: Style model for fill properties: FillParams (color, paint server, opacity, fill rule) and the FillRule nonzero/evenodd discriminator.

nodes.name: gradient.rs
nodes.summary: Gradient style/parse model: PaintServer references, linear/radial gradient definitions with gradient units, spread method, gradient stops, and attribute parsing.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle, dispatching to pattern, gradient, or solid-color rendering based on the resolved paint.

nodes.name: fill_polygon
nodes.summary: Fills a polygon, resolving gradients or solid fills and tessellating complex shapes into scanline rects.

nodes.name: resolve_linear_gradient_coords
nodes.summary: Resolves linear gradient endpoint coordinates in object-bbox or user-space units.

nodes.name: resolve_radial_gradient_coords
nodes.summary: Resolves radial gradient focal point and radius in object-bbox or user-space units.

nodes.name: build_linear_fill_style
nodes.summary: Builds a linear-gradient FillStyle from resolved geometry for the tessellator.

nodes.name: build_radial_fill_style
nodes.summary: Builds a radial-gradient FillStyle from resolved geometry for the tessellator.

nodes.name: handle_pattern_fill
nodes.summary: Fills a polygon with a referenced pattern, clipping and tessellating pattern tiles into WebRender rects.

nodes.name: points_bounds
nodes.summary: Computes the bounding box of a point list.

nodes.name: lerp_color
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates two ColorF values in sRGB space.

nodes.name: lerp_color_linear
nodes.summary: Interpolates colors in linear-RGB space by converting through sRGB to linear and back.

nodes.name: color_at_t
nodes.summary: Returns the interpolated color at parameter t across gradient stops.

nodes.name: color_at_t_with_space
nodes.summary: Interpolates color at t honoring a color-interpolation space.

nodes.name: color_at_t_with_spread
nodes.summary: Interpolates color at t with spread-method (pad/reflect/repeat) normalization and clamping.

nodes.name: gradient_projection
nodes.summary: Projects a point onto a linear gradient axis to compute parameter t.

nodes.name: render_gradient
nodes.summary: Rasterizes a gradient into cells by sampling strategy-based color at each cell and emitting rects.

nodes.name: gradient_transform_matrix
nodes.summary: Builds a 2D matrix from gradient transform ops (translate/scale/rotate/skew).

nodes.name: fill_rect_with_gradient_by_id
nodes.summary: Dispatches rect fill for a referenced gradient to native or CPU rendering paths.

nodes.name: stops_to_webrender
nodes.summary: Converts gradient stops into WebRender GradientStop list with opacity applied.

nodes.name: resolve_linear_geometry
nodes.summary: Resolves linear gradient geometry for object-bbox/user-space and applies the gradient transform.

nodes.name: resolve_radial_center_radius
nodes.summary: Resolves radial gradient center and radius, accounting for non-uniform transform scaling.

nodes.name: resolve_radial_focal
nodes.summary: Resolves the radial gradient focal point in object-bbox/user-space.

nodes.name: resolve_gradient
nodes.summary: Fully resolves a gradient definition into either a native WebRender gradient or a CPU render plan.

nodes.name: push_linear_native
nodes.summary: Emits a native WebRender linear gradient display item.

nodes.name: push_radial_native
nodes.summary: Emits a native WebRender radial gradient display item.

nodes.name: render_linear
nodes.summary: CPU-rasterizes a linear gradient using the LinearStrategy.

nodes.name: render_radial
nodes.summary: CPU-rasterizes a radial gradient using the RadialStrategy.

nodes.name: draw_cell
nodes.summary: Emits a single WebRender rect cell for gradient rasterization.

nodes.name: GradientStrategy
nodes.summary: Trait defining the interface for gradient rasterization strategies (stops, cell_size, compute_t).

nodes.name: LinearStrategy
nodes.summary: Linear gradient strategy holding stops, endpoints, and offsets for cell-based rasterization.

nodes.name: RadialStrategy
nodes.summary: Radial gradient strategy holding stops, focal point, radius, and offsets.

nodes.name: dash_intervals
nodes.summary: Computes dash/gap intervals along a segment from a stroke-dasharray and offset.

nodes.name: stroke_line_segment
nodes.summary: Renders a single stroked line segment, handling solid/gradient/dashed strokes via rotated reference frames.

nodes.name: fill_gradient_stroke
nodes.summary: Fills a stroked line segment with a gradient, clipping to the stroke geometry.

nodes.name: emit_rotated_rects_for_segment
nodes.summary: Emits rotated rects (with caps) for a dashed stroke segment.

nodes.name: draw_capped_rect
nodes.summary: Draws a rect with line-cap rounding/squaring via clip chains.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a (possibly rounded) rectangle using WebRender borders or gradient/clip fallbacks.

nodes.name: stroke_polyline
nodes.summary: Strokes a polyline by emitting per-segment stroke rects, with gradient or solid coloring.

nodes.name: stroke_polyline_gradient
nodes.summary: Strokes a polyline with a gradient by subdividing segments and sampling gradient colors per piece.

nodes.name: draw_rotated_stroke_segment
nodes.summary: Draws a single rotated stroke segment rectangle with caps.

nodes.name: TransformResult
nodes.summary: Result of applying a transform op: child origin, spatial id, and whether a frame was pushed.

nodes.name: apply_transform_op
nodes.summary: Applies a single transform op (translate/scale/rotate/skew/matrix) by pushing a WebRender reference frame.

nodes.name: push_reference_frame
nodes.summary: Pushes a WebRender reference frame with a layout transform.

nodes.name: build_rotation_transform
nodes.summary: Builds a rotation matrix about a center point.

nodes.name: op_to_matrix
nodes.summary: Converts a TransformOp into a 2D transformation matrix.

nodes.name: compute_transform_matrix
nodes.summary: Composes a sequence of transform ops into a single 2D matrix.

nodes.name: compute_transform_scale
nodes.summary: Computes the effective scale factor from a transform matrix (including determinant).

nodes.name: to_layout_transform
nodes.summary: Converts a 2D Transform2D into a WebRender LayoutTransform.

nodes.name: parse_css_color
nodes.summary: Parses a CSS color string (hex, named, rgb/rgba/hsl) into a ColorF.

nodes.name: FillParams
nodes.summary: Fill style parameters: color, paint server reference, opacity, and fill rule.

nodes.name: FillRule
nodes.summary: Fill rule discriminator (NonZero / EvenOdd) for polygon filling.

nodes.name: PaintServer
nodes.summary: Paint source reference: solid color, gradient id, or pattern id.

nodes.name: GradientDef
nodes.summary: Gradient definition discriminator (Linear / Radial).

nodes.name: GradientLength
nodes.summary: Gradient coordinate length as Number or Percentage, with object-bbox/user-space conversion.

nodes.name: LinearGradient
nodes.summary: Linear gradient definition (id, endpoints, units, stops, transform, spread method).

nodes.name: RadialGradient
nodes.summary: Radial gradient definition (id, center, radius, focal point, stops, transform, spread).

nodes.name: GradientStop
nodes.summary: A single gradient stop with offset and color.

nodes.name: from_attr
nodes.summary: Parses a paint attribute string into a PaintServer reference (solid color or url(#id) gradient/pattern).

nodes.name: parse_gradient_element
nodes.summary: Parses linear/radial gradient element attributes (stops, units, spread, transform) into a GradientDef.

nodes.name: hints.rs
nodes.summary: RenderHints struct and rendering-mode enums (vector-effect, color-rendering, color-interpolation, shape-rendering, paint-order, text-rendering, image-rendering).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Aggregates the style module: NodeStyle (visibility, display, fill, stroke, hints, effects, opacity, markers) with visibility/display helpers, re-exporting all submodules.

nodes.name: node_effects.rs
nodes.summary: NodeEffects style model referencing clip-path, mask, and filter definitions applied to a node.

nodes.name: stroke.rs
nodes.summary: Stroke style model: StrokeParams (color, paint server, width, caps/joins, miter limit, dash array) and LineCap/LineJoin discriminators.

nodes.name: transform_ops.rs
nodes.summary: TransformOp enum (translate/scale/rotate/skew/matrix) and parse_transform_str parser converting SVG transform attribute strings into operation lists, with unit tests.

nodes.name: visibility.rs
nodes.summary: Visibility and Display enums for controlling node rendering.

nodes.name: tessellator.rs
nodes.summary: CPU polygon triangulation (via lyon) and scanline-fill rasterization: converts polygons into triangles and emits per-scanline WebRender rects for solid, gradient, and pattern fills.

nodes.name: RenderHints
nodes.summary: Rendering hints struct aggregating vector-effect, color/shape/text/image rendering, color interpolation, and paint order.

nodes.name: MarkerRefs
nodes.summary: References to marker definitions for path start, mid, and end.

nodes.name: NodeStyle
nodes.summary: Per-node style aggregate: visibility, display, fill, stroke, render hints, effects, opacity, and markers.

nodes.name: NodeEffects
nodes.summary: Node effects referencing clip-path, mask, and filter definitions.

nodes.name: StrokeParams
nodes.summary: Stroke style parameters: color, paint server, width, caps/joins, miter limit, and dash array.

nodes.name: TransformOp
nodes.summary: Transform operation enum (translate, scale, rotate, skewX, skewY, matrix).

nodes.name: parse_transform_str
nodes.summary: Parses an SVG transform attribute string into a list of TransformOp.

nodes.name: FillStyle
nodes.summary: Fill style for the scanline rasterizer: Solid, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, or Pattern.

nodes.name: tessellate_to_triangles
nodes.summary: Tessellates a polygon into triangles using the lyon fill tessellator with a fill rule and tolerance.

nodes.name: tessellate_polygon
nodes.summary: Top-level polygon fill entry: tessellates then scanline-fills triangles.

nodes.name: scanline_fill_triangles
nodes.summary: Iterates triangle index buffer and scanline-fills each triangle.

nodes.name: scanline_fill_triangle
nodes.summary: Scanline-fills a single triangle, emitting per-row rects with solid, gradient, or pattern coloring and run-length merging.

nodes.name: sort_vertices_by_y
nodes.summary: Sorts triangle vertices by y-coordinate with NaN handling.

nodes.name: emit_gradient_rect
nodes.summary: Emits a single gradient-colored scanline rect.

nodes.name: clip.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves SVG clip-path and mask definitions into WebRender clip rects and clip chains, producing the per-node clipping geometry used during traversal.

nodes.name: filter.rs
nodes.summary: Translates SVG filter definitions (blur, drop-shadow, color-matrix, flood, composite) into WebRender FilterOp lists applied as stacking-context filters.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel re-exporting the clip and filter effect resolvers.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Shared renderer helpers constructing WebRender CommonItemProperties, resolving stroke width, paint order, and shape-rendering hints used across shape renderers.

nodes.name: image.rs
nodes.summary: Renders SVG <image> elements by pushing WebRender image display items, applying the viewBox transform and a solid background rect.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Renderer module barrel declaring and re-exporting all shape renderer submodules (rect, circle, path, text, etc.) plus shared helpers and providers.

nodes.name: path.rs
nodes.summary: Core path renderer: flattens SVG paths, CPU-rasterizes complex Bezier paths via vello_cpu, converts gradients to peniko paints, and falls back to native WebRender polyline rendering when possible.
nodes.languageNotes: CPU rasterization via vello_cpu (peniko/kurbo) for complex paths; native WebRender polyline path for simple subpaths.

nodes.name: resolve_node_clip_path
nodes.summary: Resolves a node's clip-path definition into WebRender clip rects/rounded-rects and a clip chain, applying rounded-corner radius from clip geometry.

nodes.name: build_mask_clips
nodes.summary: Builds the set of WebRender clip rects for a node's mask shapes, returning a clip chain option for the mask.

nodes.name: get_filter_ops
nodes.summary: Converts a node's filter definition into an ordered list of WebRender FilterOps (blur, drop-shadow, color-matrix, flood, feImage/composite).

nodes.name: make_common_props
nodes.summary: Constructs WebRender CommonItemProperties from bounds, spatial id, and clip chain id.

nodes.name: clip_chain_option
nodes.summary: Wraps a clip chain id into an Option used by WebRender display items.

nodes.name: shape_rendering_value
nodes.summary: Selects a shape-rendering precision/speed value from render hints, falling back to a default.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders an <image> element by computing the viewBox transform and pushing image (or solid-color placeholder) display items into WebRender.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders a path, preferring native WebRender polyline rendering for simple subpaths and falling back to CPU Bezier rasterization for complex paths.

nodes.name: transform_to_affine
nodes.summary: Converts a euclid Transform2D into a vello_cpu kurbo Affine matrix.

nodes.name: rasterize_bez
nodes.summary: CPU-rasterizes a Bezier path via vello_cpu, resolving fill/stroke paints, scaling gradients, cropping to the clip rect, and emitting the resulting RGBA image through the raster sink.

nodes.name: scale_gradient
nodes.summary: Scales a peniko gradient by a uniform factor for rasterized gradient paint.

nodes.name: resolve_fill_paint
nodes.summary: Resolves a path's fill paint server into a ResolvedPaint (solid color or peniko gradient).

nodes.name: resolve_stroke_paint
nodes.summary: Resolves a path's stroke paint server into a ResolvedPaint (solid color or peniko gradient).

nodes.name: gradient_def_to_peniko
nodes.summary: Converts a GradientDef into a peniko Brush, dispatching to linear or radial conversion.

nodes.name: linear_to_peniko
nodes.summary: Converts a linear gradient definition (object-bbox or user-space) into a peniko linear Gradient.

nodes.name: radial_to_peniko
nodes.summary: Converts a radial gradient definition into a peniko two-point radial Gradient.

nodes.name: stops_to_colorstops
nodes.summary: Converts SVG gradient stops into peniko ColorStops with sRGB dynamic colors.

nodes.name: flatten_subpaths
nodes.summary: Flattens a kurbo Bezier path into a list of point-based subpaths for native WebRender rendering.

nodes.name: ResolvedPaint
nodes.summary: Enum representing a resolved paint server as either a solid color or a peniko gradient brush.

nodes.name: pattern.rs
nodes.summary: Renders SVG <pattern> fills by tiling a clipped reference-frame region and emitting each pattern shape's display items.

nodes.name: polygon.rs
nodes.summary: Renders SVG <polygon> elements, delegating to native polyline rendering for simple cases and CPU Bezier rasterization otherwise.

nodes.name: polyline.rs
nodes.summary: Renders SVG <polyline> elements with native WebRender fill/stroke helpers and provides shared native polyline and points-to-bez conversion utilities for other renderers.

nodes.name: providers.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the trait interfaces (PaintResourceProvider, ClipMaskProvider, FilterProvider, MarkerProvider) through which traversal resolves paints, clip paths, filters, and markers by id.

nodes.name: render_trait.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Render trait and RenderContext struct (accumulated transforms, scales, sinks, native-rendering flag) and the top-level dispatch to per-shape render implementations.

nodes.name: traversal.rs
nodes.summary: Recursive SVG render-tree walker: renders the tree by resolving viewBox transforms, clip/mask/filter effects, and dispatching each node/leaf to shape renderers or CPU rasterization, with native-gradient gating.

nodes.name: fill_rect_with_pattern_by_id
nodes.summary: Fills a bounds rect by tiling a pattern definition through clip and reference frames, emitting each pattern shape's display items.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders a polygon, delegating to native polyline rendering or CPU Bezier rasterization for the closed point set.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders a polyline, choosing native WebRender rendering or CPU Bezier rasterization.

nodes.name: render_native_polyline
nodes.summary: Emits a polyline via native WebRender fill/stroke items, honoring paint order.

nodes.name: render_native_stroke
nodes.summary: Strokes a polyline natively by converting points to lyon points and delegating to the stroke helper.

nodes.name: render_native_fill
nodes.summary: Fills a polyline natively by computing point bounds and delegating to the fill helper.

nodes.name: points_to_bez
nodes.summary: Converts a point list into a kurbo BezPath, optionally closing the path.

nodes.name: PaintResourceProvider
nodes.summary: Trait for resolving paint resources (gradients and patterns) by id.

nodes.name: ClipMaskProvider
nodes.summary: Trait for resolving clip-path and mask resources by id.

nodes.name: FilterProvider
nodes.summary: Trait for resolving filter definitions by id.

nodes.name: MarkerProvider
nodes.summary: Trait for resolving marker definitions by id.

nodes.name: RenderContext
nodes.summary: Carries the per-node rendering state (style, spatial/clip ids, paints, accumulated/viewbox/device scales, raster offset, native flag, sink) shared by all renderers.

nodes.name: Render
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by every shape renderer, dispatching render calls with a shared RenderContext.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Render impl for &mut RenderContext that dispatches to the appropriate shape renderer based on the node's shape kind.

nodes.name: render_svg_tree
nodes.summary: Entry point that walks an SvgRenderTree: builds the viewport clip, pushes the viewBox reference frame, and recurses into the root node.

nodes.name: build_viewport_clip
nodes.summary: Defines the WebRender clip rect and clip chain for the SVG viewport bounds.

nodes.name: push_viewbox_frame
nodes.summary: Computes the viewBox transform and pushes a WebRender reference frame applying the viewBox scale/translation.

nodes.name: render_node
nodes.summary: Recursively renders a single render-tree node: applies transforms, resolves effects, emits the element, and recurses into children.

nodes.name: resolve_node_effects
nodes.summary: Resolves a node's clip-path, mask, and filter effects into a ResolvedEffects structure via the clip/filter modules.

nodes.name: apply_node_transforms
nodes.summary: Applies a node's transform list, updating the spatial id and accumulated scale via the transform helpers.

nodes.name: emit_element
nodes.summary: Dispatches a node to either geometry emission (shape) or leaf emission (text/image) based on its tag.

nodes.name: emit_geometry
nodes.summary: Emits a shape's display items, pushing a filter stacking context when filters are present and delegating to emit_shape.

nodes.name: emit_shape
nodes.summary: Emits a shape: prefers native gradients, else CPU-rasterizes the Bezier path, and emits markers.

nodes.name: emit_native_gradients
nodes.summary: Emits shapes with resolvable native gradients directly via WebRender, gating on gradient resolvability and dash absence.

nodes.name: style_has_pattern
nodes.summary: Checks whether a style's fill or stroke references a pattern paint server.

nodes.name: shape_vertices
nodes.summary: Extracts the flattened vertex points of a shape's Bezier path for marker placement.

nodes.name: emit_markers
nodes.summary: Emits start/mid/end markers for a shape's vertices.

nodes.name: emit_marker
nodes.summary: Emits a single marker by positioning/rotating the marker shape and CPU-rasterizing it.

nodes.name: push_filter_context
nodes.summary: Pushes a WebRender stacking context carrying the node's filter ops.

nodes.name: emit_leaf
nodes.summary: Emits a leaf node (text/image), pushing a filter context and mask clip, then delegating to the leaf's render.

nodes.name: recurse_children
nodes.summary: Recursively renders all children of a container node, threading accumulated state.

nodes.name: compute_viewbox_transform
nodes.summary: Computes the viewBox scale and offset (preserving aspect ratio) mapping viewBox coordinates into the viewport.

nodes.name: render_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core SVG render-tree data model: SvgRenderTree/SvgRenderNode, shape and container tags, viewport/viewbox, paint-server definitions (gradients, patterns, clip paths, masks, filters, markers), and the visitor traits used to traverse it.
nodes.languageNotes: Models the full SVG element/attribute surface with Rust enums and structs (derive macros); the visitor pattern (accept/accept_mut) lets the renderer traverse the tree generically.

nodes.name: circle.rs
nodes.summary: Renders a Circle shape by delegating to the ellipse renderer, since a circle is an ellipse with equal radii.

nodes.name: ellipse.rs
nodes.summary: Renders an Ellipse shape by approximating it with a rounded rectangle and delegating to the rect renderer.

nodes.name: line.rs
nodes.summary: Renders a Line shape by stroking a line segment between its two endpoints when a stroke is present.

nodes.name: rect.rs
nodes.summary: Renders a Rectangle shape: computes bounds and corner radii, emits a rounded-rect clip, then fills and strokes in the correct paint order.

nodes.name: circle.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Circle shape (cx, cy, r) and its clip geometry computation for clipping to a circle's bounding region.

nodes.name: ellipse.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Ellipse shape (cx, cy, rx, ry) and its clip geometry computation.

nodes.name: AspectRatio
nodes.summary: Holds a parsed preserveAspectRatio value: an AspectAlign and a MeetOrSlice.

nodes.name: SvgRenderTree
nodes.summary: Top-level container for the SVG render tree: holds the root node, viewport, and lookup maps for gradients, patterns, clip paths, masks, filters, and markers.

nodes.name: SvgRenderNode
nodes.summary: A single node in the render tree: id, tag, style, transforms, viewport, and child nodes, with visitor accept methods.

nodes.name: SvgTag
nodes.summary: Enum classifying a render node as a Shape, Text, Image, or Container.

nodes.name: Container
nodes.summary: Enum of container element types: Group, Svg, Defs, Use, Symbol, and Text.

nodes.name: ViewBox
nodes.summary: Represents an SVG viewBox with min_x, min_y, width, and height.

nodes.name: ViewportInfo
nodes.summary: Describes a viewport's width, height, optional view_box, overflow_visible flag, and aspect ratio.

nodes.name: SvgViewport
nodes.summary: Positioned viewport (x, y, width, height) with view_box, aspect_ratio, and overflow_visible attributes.

nodes.name: ClipPathDef
nodes.summary: Clip path definition: the list of shapes and the clip-path units (objectBoundingBox or userSpaceOnUse).

nodes.name: MaskDef
nodes.summary: Mask definition: the list of shapes that define the mask.

nodes.name: FilterPrimitive
nodes.summary: Enum of filter primitive kinds: GaussianBlur, DropShadow, ColorMatrix, Saturate, LuminanceToAlpha, Offset, Flood, Composite, Tile, and Image.

nodes.name: FilterDef
nodes.summary: Filter definition: the ordered primitives plus the filter region (x, y, width, height).

nodes.name: PatternDef
nodes.summary: Pattern definition: tile geometry, pattern/content units, transform, optional viewBox/aspect ratio, and the tile shapes.

nodes.name: MarkerDef
nodes.summary: Marker definition: shapes, viewBox, reference point, marker size, units, and orientation for line markers.

nodes.name: SvgRenderTreeVisitor
nodes.summary: Trait for traversing the render tree; visit_node returns a VisitDecision.

nodes.name: SvgRenderTreeVisitorMut
nodes.summary: Trait for mutably traversing the render tree; visit_node_mut returns a VisitDecision.

nodes.name: parse_aspect_ratio
nodes.summary: Parses an SVG preserveAspectRatio attribute string into an AspectRatio, handling the 'defer' keyword, alignment, and meet/slice.

nodes.name: extract_viewbox
nodes.summary: Parses an SVG viewBox attribute string into a ViewBox struct.

nodes.name: accept
nodes.summary: Visitor entry point: invokes visit_node on self then recurses into children, honoring SkipChildren/Stop decisions.

nodes.name: accept_mut
nodes.summary: Mutable visitor entry point: invokes visit_node_mut then recurses into children, honoring visit decisions.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Render impl for Circle: delegates to the ellipse renderer since a circle is an ellipse with equal radii.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Render impl for Ellipse: approximates the ellipse as a rounded rectangle and delegates to the rect renderer.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Render impl for Line: strokes a line segment between the two endpoints when a stroke color or paint server is present.

nodes.name: rect_bounds_and_radii
nodes.summary: Computes a rectangle's bounding LayoutRect and corner radii, resolving missing radii and clamping to half the box size.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Render impl for Rectangle: emits a rounded-rect clip and paints fill and stroke in the correct paint order.

nodes.name: Circle
nodes.summary: Shape data for SVG <circle>: center (cx, cy) and radius (r).

nodes.name: clip_info
nodes.summary: Computes clip geometry for a circle as a rounded rectangle or a bounding rect depending on radius.

nodes.name: Ellipse
nodes.summary: Shape data for SVG <ellipse>: center (cx, cy) and radii (rx, ry).

nodes.name: clip_info
nodes.summary: Computes clip geometry for an ellipse as a rounded rectangle or a bounding rect depending on radii.

nodes.name: line.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Line shape (x1, y1, x2, y2) as a simple data struct.

nodes.summary: Defines the Path shape wrapping a kurbo BezPath and computes its clip geometry from segment bounds.

nodes.summary: Defines the Polygon shape (a closed set of points) and its clip geometry via clip_points.

nodes.name: polyline.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Polyline shape (an open set of points) plus the shared clip_points helper for point-list bounds.

nodes.name: rectangle.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Rectangle shape (x, y, width, height, rx, ry) and computes its rounded-rect clip geometry.

nodes.name: Line
nodes.summary: Shape data for SVG <line>: endpoints (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

nodes.name: ClipGeometry
nodes.summary: Enum describing the clip geometry emitted for a shape: either a rounded rectangle or a polygon.

nodes.name: Shape
nodes.summary: Discriminated union of all SVG shape types (Rect, Circle, Ellipse, Line, Polyline, Polygon, Path) with clip_info and to_bez_path methods.

nodes.name: Path
nodes.summary: Shape data for SVG <path>: wraps a kurbo BezPath.

nodes.name: Polygon
nodes.summary: Shape data for SVG <polygon>: a closed list of points.

nodes.name: Polyline
nodes.summary: Shape data for SVG <polyline>: an open list of points.

nodes.name: Rectangle
nodes.summary: Shape data for SVG <rect>: position (x, y), size (width, height), and corner radii (rx, ry).

nodes.summary: Dispatches clip geometry computation to the concrete shape's clip_info implementation.

nodes.name: to_bez_path
nodes.summary: Converts a Shape into a kurbo BezPath for rasterization, using native shape constructors or point-based paths.

nodes.name: points_to_bez
nodes.summary: Builds a kurbo BezPath from a point list, optionally closing the path.

nodes.name: all_equal_radius
nodes.summary: Determines whether two radii are equal within a LayoutSize tolerance, used for rounded-rect clip decisions.

nodes.name: clip_info
nodes.summary: Computes clip geometry for a path by scanning its segments to find the bounding box.

nodes.name: clip_points
nodes.summary: Computes the bounding box of a point list, returning a polygon clip geometry.

nodes.name: clip_info

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The README lays out the engine's core idea: it walks a pre-built SvgRenderTree and emits a WebRender display list, CPU-rasterizing complex paths and non-native gradients via vello_cpu while pushing simple shapes and native gradients as direct WebRender primitives, all inline in document order. It also documents the module architecture — data model, traversal, renderer, effects, and tessellator — and the key design decision that an inline RasterSink preserves z-order between CPU rasters and native primitives. This is the roadmap for the tour ahead.

tour.title: Crate Entry & Public API
tour.description: The crate root exposes the public API: render_svg_tree (re-exported from traversal), the RasterSink bridge that turns rasterized output into WebRender display-list items, and the RasterizedImage / RasterImageUploader / GradientKind types. Everything downstream — the render tree, style model, renderers, effects, and tessellator — is reachable from here. This is the single public surface the layout layer and the rest of Servo call into.
tour.languageLesson: Rust's `pub use` re-export lets a crate root present a clean public API while keeping implementation modules private; lib.rs re-exports render_svg_tree from traversal rather than redefining it.

tour.title: Render Tree & Data Model
tour.description: The render tree (render_tree.rs) is the engine's central data model: SvgRenderTree/SvgRenderNode, shape and container tags, viewport/viewBox, and the paint-server definitions (gradients, patterns, clip paths, masks, filters, markers). The shapes module defines the Shape and ClipGeometry enums plus each concrete shape type and its geometry helpers. These are the highest-fan-in data-model files in the graph — nearly every renderer, effect, and the traversal walk depend on them.
tour.languageLesson: Shape and ClipGeometry are Rust enums — closed sets of variants that carry data — so downstream code pattern-matches exhaustively instead of relying on inheritance, a common Rust alternative to class hierarchies.

tour.title: Style & Attribute Model
tour.description: The style module aggregates everything about how a node is painted: NodeStyle (visibility, display, fill, stroke, hints, effects, opacity, markers) in mod.rs, with FillParams/FillRule, StrokeParams/LineCap/LineJoin, PaintServer gradient definitions, and the TransformOp list with its string parser. The traversal and renderers read NodeStyle to decide how each shape is drawn. Style files carry no WebRender dependency, keeping parsing and modeling pure and testable.

tour.title: Traversal Walk
tour.description: traversal.rs is the recursive heart of the pipeline: it resolves viewBox transforms, applies clip/mask/filter effects, and dispatches each node to a shape renderer or to CPU rasterization, gated by whether a native gradient can be used. The visitor.rs PaintServerFixupVisitor runs first to rewrite PaintServer references (e.g. pattern-backed references) before the walk. This is where the README's pipeline — render_svg_tree to render_node to emit_element — actually executes.
tour.languageLesson: The visitor pattern (PaintServerFixupVisitor) performs a pre-pass mutation over the tree before rendering, separating tree-rewriting concerns from the render walk itself.

tour.title: Renderer Trait & Dispatch
tour.description: The Render trait and RenderContext (accumulated transforms, scales, sinks, and the native-rendering flag) are the contract every shape renderer implements, with render_trait.rs holding the top-level dispatch to per-shape implementations. providers.rs defines the trait interfaces — PaintResourceProvider, ClipMaskProvider, FilterProvider, MarkerProvider — through which traversal resolves paints, clips, filters, and markers by id. helpers.rs supplies shared WebRender CommonItemProperties and hint resolution, and renderer/mod.rs is the barrel re-exporting all of these — the highest fan-in file in the entire graph.
tour.languageLesson: The Render trait is Rust's interface for 'things that can draw themselves': each shape type implements it, and dispatch happens by enum-matching on Shape with a shared RenderContext rather than through dynamic dispatch.

tour.title: Shape Renderers
tour.description: Each shape renderer turns one Shape variant into WebRender display items. rect.rs emits a rounded-rect clip then fills and strokes in the correct paint order; path.rs flattens SVG paths and CPU-rasterizes complex Beziers via vello_cpu, falling back to native polyline rendering when possible; polygon.rs and polyline.rs handle point lists; and text.rs emits glyph runs with anchor and baseline offsets. Circle, ellipse, and line are thin delegates — circle reuses the ellipse renderer, and ellipse reuses rect.

tour.title: Paint Pipelines
tour.description: fill.rs, stroke.rs, and gradient.rs are the shared paint machinery every shape renderer calls. fill.rs resolves solid colors, linear/radial gradients, and patterns into display-list commands with a tessellation fallback; stroke.rs computes dash intervals, stroked-rectangle borders, polyline strokes, and gradient strokes; and gradient.rs does sRGB/linear-RGB interpolation, spread methods, and strategy-based CPU rasterization. pattern.rs tiles a clipped reference-frame region to paint pattern fills. These are the cross-cutting paint features the README calls out.

tour.title: Effects: Clip, Mask, Filter
tour.description: clip.rs resolves clip-path and mask definitions into WebRender clip rects and clip chains, and filter.rs translates filter definitions (blur, drop-shadow, color-matrix, flood, composite) into WebRender FilterOp lists applied as stacking-context filters. Traversal applies these per node, which is why effects form a distinct layer from the renderer. effects/mod.rs barrels the two resolvers together.

tour.title: Tessellation & CPU Rasterization
tour.description: tessellator.rs is where CPU rasterization happens: it triangulates polygons (via lyon) and performs scanline fills, emitting per-scanline WebRender rects for solid, gradient, and pattern fills. This is the fallback that handles the complex shapes and gradients the native path cannot, which is why the engine can rasterize anything regardless of WebRender's capabilities. Its output flows back into the RasterSink bridge introduced in Step 2.
tour.languageLesson: Scanline rasterization is the classic software-graphics technique: a polygon is broken into triangles, then filled one horizontal row at a time — here each scanline becomes a thin WebRender rect.

tour.title: Layout Integration
tour.description: The layout side builds the SvgRenderTree from DOM nodes. builder.rs recursively walks layout nodes, builds shape/text/image nodes, resolves <use> references, and collects paint definitions; defines.rs parses reusable paint-server elements (<defs>); geometry.rs constructs shape/text geometry from DOM attributes; and style.rs resolves computed CSS and presentation attributes into NodeStyle. This is the other end of the pipeline — DOM in, SvgRenderTree out, ready for render_svg_tree in Step 2.

tour.title: Build & Dependencies
tour.description: The Cargo.toml declares the crate's workspace dependencies — webrender_api (the display-list target), euclid (geometry), kurbo and lyon (path/tessellation), and vello_cpu (CPU rasterization) — revealing the engine as a pure-Rust software renderer. It closes the loop on how the crate is built and which external libraries each layer leans on.
